L01_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L01_narrator.wav.text: Last weekend, I took a quick bullet train trip to Kyoto to see the autumn leaves.

L02_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L02_narrator.wav.text: As soon as I arrived at Kyoto Station, the city was packed with tourists.

L03_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L03_narrator.wav.text: First, I decided to head over to Kiyomizu Temple before the afternoon crowds got worse.

L04_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L04_narrator.wav.text: The view from the wooden stage was breathtaking, especially with the vibrant red trees.

L05_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L05_narrator.wav.text: While walking down the narrow hill, I ran into an old couple from Canada.

L06_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L06_narrator.wav.text: They told me that they were looking for a cozy local noodle shop for lunch.

L07_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L07_narrator.wav.text: Luckily, I knew a hidden spot just around the corner that serves amazing matcha soba.

L08_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L08_narrator.wav.text: We ended up having lunch together and chatted about our favorite travel destinations.

L09_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L09_narrator.wav.text: Later that night, I strolled along the peaceful Gion district under the lanterns.

L10_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L10_narrator.wav.text: It was such a memorable short trip that I cannot wait to visit again.
